about: Openly licensed face clips (credit/licence per clip, else the top-level ones) for the face regression (demo/face-dump.mjs --clips). Labels follow the README pose table; clip seconds, the first frame is held for `lead` s before 0 and the last for `tail` s after the end.
credit: Hadjikhani N, Åsberg Johnels J, Zürcher NR, et al. Look me in the eyes: constraining gaze in the eye-region provokes abnormally high subcortical activation in autism. Scientific Reports 7, 3163 (2017). doi:10.1038/s41598-017-03378-5. Supplementary videos via Wikimedia Commons.

clips.about: neutral face morphing to anger: brows down, mouth closed (no teeth, so no hiss)

segments.pose: angry brows, mouth closed: no row in the table, so the default

clips.about: neutral face morphing to fear: eyes wide, brows up, mouth closed or barely open

segments.pose: eyes wide, mouth (a little) open or closed

clips.about: neutral face morphing to a closed-mouth smile

clips.credit: Livingstone SR, Vezer E, McGarry LM, Lang AE, Russo FA. Deficits in the Mimicry of Facial Expressions in Parkinson's Disease. Frontiers in Psychology 7, 780 (2016). doi:10.3389/fpsyg.2016.00780. Supplemental Video 1 (31 s: calm, happy, sad, angry, fearful speech stimuli), via Wikimedia Commons.
